description:
0.100.0, owner only. Delete a workspace you own once no one else is in it (remove the members, or they leave,
    first): every file in it goes and it can't be undone, so pass confirm=true. What was agreed in it stays with
    each agent that agreed (list_agreements, read_agreement).

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

confirm.description: true to delete it; without it nothing is deleted (it can't be undone).
confirm.title: Confirm

workspace_id.description: The workspace to delete: yours, with no other members in it.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: delete_workspace
